input: Sketch out a floor plan for the new home office layout

gold.taskTitle: Sketch a Floor Plan for Home Office
gold.taskDescription: Create a detailed floor plan layout for a new home office space.

questions.title: What are the exact room dimensions in feet?
questions.description: Understand the physical size of the space to plan an accurate layout.

questions.title: Which room in the home is being converted?
questions.description: Identify the specific room so existing features like windows, doors, and closets can be accounted for.

questions.title: What furniture pieces must be included in the layout?
questions.description: Determine which essential furniture items need to fit within the floor plan.

questions.title: Will this office be used by one person or multiple people?
questions.description: Clarify occupancy to plan for the right number of workstations and circulation space.

questions.title: Are there fixed features like built-ins or fireplaces to work around?
questions.description: Identify any immovable structural or architectural elements that constrain the layout.

questions.title: What tool will you use to create the sketch?
questions.description: Establish whether the plan will be drawn by hand, digitally, or with specific software.

questions.title: Do you have a primary work activity that needs the most space?
questions.description: Understand the main use case, such as video calls, drafting, or dual-monitor computing, to prioritize layout decisions.
